# NBC Bay Area

> > NBC Bay Area is the primary news source for the San Francisco Bay Area, delivering breaking news, weather forecasts, investigations, and regional coverage across San Francisco, San Jose, and surrounding communities.

NBC Bay Area serves the greater Bay Area region with comprehensive local news coverage, detailed weather information including microclimate forecasts, and investigative reporting on consumer protection and community issues. The site also covers major events and sports affecting the region.

## Key Topics

- Bay Area news
- San Francisco
- San Jose
- Weather forecasts
- Heat waves
- Breaking news
- Investigations
- East Bay
- South Bay
- Temperature records
- Weather alerts
- Community events
- Local news
- NBC Universal

## Core News & Weather

- [NBC Bay Area Homepage](https://www.nbcbayarea.com): NBC Bay Area homepage with Bay Area news, weather, and breaking news
- [Local News Hub](https://www.nbcbayarea.com/news/local): Local news hub covering Bay Area, San Francisco, San Jose and East Bay
- [Weather Forecasts & Alerts](https://www.nbcbayarea.com/weather): Weather forecasts, radar and microclimate data for Bay Area cities
